## reference · ChatGPT vs Perplexity AI
* Only 11% of domains are cited by both ChatGPT and Perplexity.
* ChatGPT has 900 million weekly active users, while Perplexity has 22-45 million monthly active users.
* ChatGPT processes 2.5 billion prompts per day and holds 64.6% of global generative AI website traffic.
* Perplexity averages 21.9 citations per response, while ChatGPT averages 10.4.
* ChatGPT mentions brands 3.2 times more often than it cites them with links.
* 48.7% of ChatGPT citations come from third-party listings like Yelp and TripAdvisor.
* Wikipedia accounts for 16.3% of ChatGPT's top-cited domain share.
* 67% of ChatGPT's top 1,000 cited pages are off-limits to brand SEO.
* Perplexity has a high authority bias and cites content updated within 30 days 82% of the time.
* ChatGPT generates 87.4% of all AI referral traffic, while Perplexity drives 2.8%.
* Perplexity-referred sessions convert at 10.5%, while ChatGPT-referred sessions convert at 15.9%.
* ChatGPT launched ads in February 2026, while Perplexity abandoned its ad pilot.
* Brands can get paid visibility on ChatGPT through sponsored placements, but not on Perplexity.
* Organic visibility becomes more valuable on ChatGPT with the existence of paid placements.
* Tracking both ChatGPT and Perplexity becomes more important due to their diverging monetization strategies.
* Optimization tactics for ChatGPT and Perplexity are distinct due to their different algorithms and user bases.
